strings.tl: What were you trying to do?

strings.en: {1c:10}How pathetic...
strings.tl: How pathetic...

strings.jp:
{1c:10}やめましょうよ、{10}さん。
一応止めましたからね。
strings.read:
{1c:10}やめましょうよ、{10}さん。
一応止めましたからね。
strings.en:
{1c:10}Let's not, {10}-san. I did try to
stop you, for the record.
strings.tl: Let's not, [HERO]-san. I did try to stop you, for the record.

strings.jp:
{1c:10}あらら・・・{1a}じゃあぼくは失礼しますね。
次の標的にされたら
たまりませんから。
strings.read:
{1c:10}あらら・・・{1a}じゃあぼくは失礼しますね。
次の標的にされたら
たまりませんから。
strings.en:
{1c:10}Oh dear...{1a}Then I'll take my leave. I could hardly bear
being your next target.
strings.tl: Oh dear... // Then I'll take my leave. I could hardly bear being your next target.

strings.en: {1c:10}Well then, that settles that.{0c:1501}
strings.tl: Well then, that settles that.

strings.en: {1c:10}Is your head quite all right?{0c:153b0700}
strings.tl: Is your head quite all right?

strings.jp:
{1c:10}君の{e0a1}壊癖はいつになったら
直るんですかね。
strings.read:
{1c:10}君の破壊癖はいつになったら
直るんですかね。
strings.en:
{1c:10}When will you ever cure your habit of
destruction, I wonder.
strings.tl: When will you ever cure your habit of destruction, I wonder.

strings.jp: {1c:10}あの・・・バレバレですよ。
strings.read: {1c:10}あの・・・バレバレですよ。
strings.en: {1c:10}Um... I can see right through that.
strings.tl: Um... I can see right through that.

strings.jp:
{1c:10}君を見てると確かに飽きないんですが、
疲れているときに見るとさすがにうんざりします。
strings.read:
{1c:10}君を見てると確かに飽きないんですが、
疲れているときに見るとさすがにうんざりします。
strings.en:
{1c:10}I will admit you are never dull to watch,
but when I am tired, I do have my fill of
it.
strings.tl: I will admit you are never dull to watch, but when I am tired, I do have my fill of it.

strings.en: {1c:10}So, what were you trying to do?
strings.tl: So, what were you trying to do?

strings.jp: {1c:10}痛みに慣れちゃいましたね・・・
strings.read: {1c:10}痛みに慣れちゃいましたね・・・
strings.en: {1c:10}I seem to have grown used to the pain...
strings.tl: I seem to have grown used to the pain...

strings.jp:
{1c:10}目の前で人が血を流しているのに
何も感じない・・・
なんとも情けない人間です、ぼくは。
strings.read:
{1c:10}目の前で人が血を流しているのに
何も感じない・・・
なんとも情けない人間です、ぼくは。
strings.en:
{1c:10}Someone is bleeding right before my
eyes, and I feel nothing... What a pathetic
human being I am.
strings.tl: Someone is bleeding right before my eyes, and I feel nothing... What a pathetic human being I am.
